section: Truepoint: wealth management firm chose Zoom Rooms with Poly Trio for its new Cincinnati headquarters
body:
Truepoint is a wealth management company in Cincinnati that moved to a new headquarters and asked AVI-SPL to shape its collaboration spaces. This part of the case study covers the challenge and the platform and device decisions.

**The organization and the problem**
- Truepoint offers financial advisory services such as investment management, estate planning and tax planning, which the page says benefit from face-to-face contact with clients. It takes a personalized approach centered on clients' life goals.
- The firm had been growing its team and was outgrowing its headquarters, where the meeting rooms had outdated technology. Truepoint Technology Specialist Brad Felix called the former space "a jumble of different equipment" on two floors.
- The new premises were a blank slate that would put staff and guests on one level.
- Steve Condon, Truepoint president and principal, said the challenge was to work out how to share ideas internally and collaborate digitally with clients, which the old space was not set up for. He wanted the office to support daily collaboration and personal client relationships.
- The technology had to serve people meeting in the new headquarters and people joining from remote locations.

**How the project was set up**
- Truepoint first completed an internal assessment of the technology it wanted and the likely use cases for employees and clients.
- Company leadership entrusted AVI-SPL as advisor, decision maker and integrator, and expected guidance on the solutions that would meet its goals.
- Felix said the project was about reducing friction between clients and advisors when they connect virtually, and that AVI-SPL's vision matched Truepoint's: simplify the rooms, make experiences consistent, and make collaboration easy for clients and employees.
- AVI-SPL Account Manager Steven Mason said the first task was to determine the UC platform for calls and collaboration in the conference rooms.

**What was chosen**
- Truepoint already used Microsoft Teams and Zoom software at the desktop. AVI-SPL and Truepoint agreed on Zoom as the UC platform for rooms of different size and purpose: living-room-style areas for relaxed conversations, traditional conference rooms and client meeting spaces.
- Poly Trio was selected by both teams, for its all-in-one capabilities, as the centerpiece of most spaces and the device used to launch the Zoom Rooms. Felix cited its clean touch interface and its speaker, mic and control functions.
- Samsung displays show video conferencing participants and visual media.
- AVI-SPL recommended a mix of Poly Studio and Crestron Flex soundbars. Poly Studio went into the living-room-style areas, and Crestron Flex into the more traditional but highly flexible conferencing spaces.

**When to use this**
For questions about a smaller professional-services firm choosing Zoom Rooms, or how AVI-SPL advises on platform choice for a new office.

**Not stated in this source**
No room counts, prices or device quantities.
